titleStmt.title: To Hiki Tatewaki, Retainer of Bizen, No Shoshô.

div.head: To Hiki Tatewaki, Retainer of Bizen, No Shoshô.
div.p: On the occasion of your passing through Kobé weapons were used against foreigners on the pretext that they had broken your ranks, and in aggravation of this the Americans and French, who were trying to escape, and also the foreign ministers, were fired upon, nor was any attempt made to arrange the matter there. This is an outrageous and criminal act. The reformation at present in course of being carried out causes much anxiety to the Imperial bosom, especially in the case of foreign relations, in which is greatly concerned the stability of the nation. His Majesty is determined, whilst preserving his own dignity, to act in accordance with the public law of the universe, and to perform those things which are right and proper.
To have disregarded this state of things, and to have, on the contrary, acted in a way calculated to cause shame to his Majesty, is a flagrant crime, and one which cannot be passed over.
The man who gave the order to fire is therefore condemned to perform hara-kiri in the presence of witnesses of the different nationalities.
To Hiki Tatewaki, Retainer of Bizen, No Shoshô.

When you were passing through Kobé your followers committed an outrage on foreigners. As this is an act which cannot be passed over, they are punished for it. But as his Majesty is of opinion that it proceeded from the said man’s (Hiki Tatewaki’s) orders not being properly enforced, it is ordered that he be kept under arrest. Dated second month.

closer.signed: TAKI ZENZABURO, (aged 32,) Retainer of Hiki Tatewaki, of Bizen.
